display.pinyin: wǒ zài yě bù mǎi zhè zhǒng shū le 。
display.meaning: I will never buy this kind of book again.

choices.label: I intend to buy this kind of book again.
choices.feedback: I will never buy this kind of book again. Put the continuing negative before the action to say it will not happen again. The final change particle can mark a new decision; this does not say the action never happened before. 再也没 refers to an absence since a past point; 再也不 can be a future resolve. 怎么也/都 + 不/没 expresses inability despite attempts; 不 and 没 keep their usual non-event/event contrast.
